span.p:
先确定当前付费执行窗口
可能只是完整 2 个月计划里的前 1 个月

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
写入 start_date
付款日不等于训练起点

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
开始 / 继续 execution
status = in_progress

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
completed
扣 1 个训练日 credit

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
不扣 credit
下次继续同一进度
预计完成日顺延

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
abandoned
当前模型不按 completed 扣 credit
如要扣需改规则

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: usedCredits = 唯一 completed day_index 数

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
计划进度可 resolved
但 credit 口径需单独判断

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
totalCredits = 当前付费窗口内的训练日数量
例：完整计划 8 周，但本轮只买 4 周
只统计前 4 周窗口

span.p:
可继续训练
即使旧 end_date 已过也不能误拦截

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
不能继续新训练
可续费 / 宽限 / 后续自动取消
